transport_rule: asset_ref and SHA256 only; image paths, pixels, masks, thumbnails and overlays are forbidden

business_trial_parameter_contract.selection_rule: trial_model_id and annotation_click_mode are selected only from the corresponding GetCapability catalogues; no paths, checkpoints or arbitrary artifact digests are accepted.

evolution_policy.upgrade_rule: new model or dataset versions run as parallel trial candidates through the same request, status, receipt, inference and human-review flow
evolution_policy.rollback_rule: retain prior immutable receipts and mark the candidate ROLLED_BACK; do not delete evidence or promote a model
evolution_policy.breaking_change_rule: a changed geometry contract, request schema, receipt schema or error-code meaning requires a new major capability version and parallel acceptance
